heading: Your NHS App:
tagline: Easy Access to Your Care Anytime
otherDownload: Other ways to download the NHS App
helpText: Contact your GP surgery for help with services provided by your practice, or visit the official NHS App help centre.
emergency: For a life-threatening emergency call 999. For urgent medical help use NHS 111.
video: Watch official NHS App video guides
footer: Patient information guide · Content review required before publication
disclaimer: This is an informational guide, not the NHS App. Never enter NHS login details on this page.
loginLink: create or sign in to your NHS login
loginSuffix: using your email address (official NHS website).

sections.title: Getting started
steps: Download the NHS App from the App Store or Google Play.
Open the app and create an NHS login with your email address, or sign in if you already have one.
Follow the instructions to verify your identity if asked.
Once signed in, open Profile and look for login settings to enable fingerprint or face recognition if your device supports it.
sections.note: You must be aged 13 or over and registered with a GP surgery in England to use NHS App services.

sections.title: Contact your GP surgery
steps: Open the NHS App and look for Appointments or the option to contact your GP surgery.
Choose Contact your GP surgery if it is available.
Complete and submit the online form.
Your surgery will explain how and when they will respond.
sections.note: This service depends on your GP surgery. Do not use an online form for emergencies.

sections.title: View test results
steps: Select Test results in the NHS App.
Read the important information and select Continue if prompted.
View any test results available to you.
sections.note: Not every result will be available immediately. Contact your care team if you have questions about a result.

sections.title: Order repeat prescriptions
steps: Select Prescriptions.
Choose Request or view prescriptions.
Select the repeat medicines you need.
Check and submit your request.
Use the NHS App to check progress where this feature is available.
sections.note: Request repeat medicines in good time. Some medicines cannot be requested through the app.

sections.title: GP surgery appointments
steps: Select Appointments.
View your GP appointments.
Book, change or cancel an appointment if your GP surgery offers these options.
sections.note: Appointment availability and options vary by surgery.

sections.title: Hospital referrals and appointments
steps: Select Appointments.
Look for Hospital referrals and appointments.
View available referral, waiting-list or appointment information.
Where supported, follow the instructions to manage an appointment.
sections.note: What you can see and manage depends on the hospital or provider.

sections.title: Messages and notifications
steps: Select Messages to read messages from your GP surgery, hospital or other NHS services.
To manage alerts, open Profile and look for Notifications.
Follow your device instructions to allow NHS App notifications.
sections.note: Notification options can vary by device.

sections.title: Manage services for someone else
steps: Open Profile.
Select Family and carer access if available.
Choose the person whose services you are authorised to manage.
Use the services available for that person and switch back to your own profile when finished.
sections.note: You must have appropriate permission to access another person’s NHS services.
